parent_domains.justification: Augmented reality relies heavily on computer vision technologies to overlay digital components onto the real world.

closest_parent_domain.justification: Computer vision is the foundation upon which augmented reality applications are built, enabling the interpretation and understanding of the visual information.

child_domains.justification: While not directly under augmented reality, virtual reality in medicine often integrates augmented reality for enhanced medical visualization.

closest_child_domain.justification: This domain frequently integrates augmented reality technologies to enhance medical training and procedures.

sibling_domains.justification: Augmented reality and virtual reality share the same parent domain of immersive technologies.

closest_sibling_domain.justification: Both augmented reality and virtual reality are closely related in terms of creating immersive experiences and often overlap in applications and technologies used.

unrelated_domains.justification: 3D vision involves comprehensively understanding three-dimensional structures independently of augmented reality.
